name: ATLAS Governance Gateway
description: A secure middleware that intercepts AI agent tool calls to evaluate risks and manage human-in-the-loop approvals via durable Inngest workflows. It ensures compliance with standards like the EU AI Act by pausing high-risk actions until authorized by a human reviewer.
